verdict.rationale: GitLab documents an official CLI (probe-3). It also ships an official GitLab Duo CLI that gives terminal access to agentic Duo Chat (docs-54). The GitLab CLI can record Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex sessions for AI governance (docs-74). Together these clearly deliver an official CLI with AI-native uses. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the CLI's command coverage and agent-oriented workflows (e.g. scripting or structured output for agents), and independent hands-on corroboration.
